#### Description

Warmboot SAD case (dur_lag_member_down) causes APPLY_VIEW failure due to unwanted ASIC operations during APPLY_VIEW.

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Warm reboot from 201811 to latest 202012 with 1 or more LAG member down from DUT side.
2.
3.

#### Describe the results you received:

1. Object count for SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_LAG_MEMBER, SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_ROUTE_ENTRY on current view is different than on temporary view
2. Logs complain about failed to find best candidate for LAG using LAG member and port
3. Too many unwanted ASIC operations on SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_ROUTE_ENTRY, SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_LAG_MEMBER.
4. One of the REMOVE operations fail the APPLY_VIEW:
	SAI_API_NEIGHBOR:brcm_sai_remove_neighbor_entry:844 Neighbor vr_id 0 NH 1 references found.
	ASIC is in inconsistent state: :- asic_process_event: failed to execute api: remove, key: SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_NEIGHBOR_ENTRY:{"ip":"10.0.0.33","rif":"oid:0x60000000016d4","switch_id":"oid:0x21000000000000"}, status: 
5. This triggers syncd to send switch_shutdown_request to OA
6. OA does not takes this well, and hits GP, as a result of which coredump is generated.

comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body: Seen on dx010, 7260 so far. Other platforms to be tested, but from the nature of issue this seems generic.

comments.author: kcudnik
comments.body: could you provide sairedis recording for this scenario ?

comments.author: kcudnik
comments.body: SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_NEIGHBOR_ENTRY is a leaf objects and it don't have any dependencies, it should be possible to remove it at any time, i think we discuss this on last issue with lag members, and it needs to be fixed by vendor

comments.author: tjchadaga
comments.body:
> RY is a leaf objects and it don't have any dependencies, it should be possible to remove it at any time, i think we discuss this on last issue with lag members, and it needs to be fixed by vendor

CS00012228971 filed with broadcom is tracking this RFE

comments.author: kcudnik
comments.body: issue is probably related to wrong matching RIF interfaces, which from syslog seems like wrong guess is taken, since rif interfaces based on lag which don't have lag members are exactly the same, so selection at random is performed. i will analyse attached logs and add pre match logic based on neighbor entry which will cause match rif interfaces

comments.author: kcudnik
comments.body: @tjchadaga sairedis.rec you attached is from warm boot only, i need also part from cold boot on 201811, otherwise i wont be able to reproduce this

comments.author: kcudnik
comments.body: Fix for master and 202012 https://github.com/Azure/sonic-sairedis/pull/1027 has been merged

comments.author: prsunny
comments.body: [Issue triage] @vaibhavhd, PRs are merged. Can you please check if this can be closed?
